summary: Inventory web applications run persistently on node2 and node3 at port 8080. Node1 serves port 80 and round-robins requests between both backends. All services, firewall rules, inventory data, and balancing recovered after sequential node restarts.

Persistently opened TCP port 8080 on both backend firewalls.
Created and enabled inventory-lb.service on node1 with round-robin forwarding and backend fallback.
Persistently opened HTTP port 80 on node1.
Verified alternating HTTP 200 responses from node2 and node3.
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.
